summary.id: Membangun aplikasi web multi-tenant, portal manajemen operasional, dan landing page berkecepatan tinggi dengan kontrol akses berbasis peran.
summary.en: Engineering multi-tenant web applications, operational dashboards, and high-speed static/SSR sites with strict role-based boundaries.

summary.id: Rekayasa aplikasi Android native berbasis Kotlin dan Jetpack Compose dengan arsitektur MVVM, sinkronisasi offline, dan notifikasi real-time.
summary.en: Native Android engineering in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose utilizing clean MVVM architecture, offline caching, and push workflows.

summary.id: Menghubungkan perangkat keras pengukur dan sensor industri melalui broker MQTT ke penyimpanan deret waktu dan dashboard pemantauan langsung.
summary.en: Bridging field hardware sensors over MQTT brokers into reliable relational/time-series storage and live browser telemetry consoles.

summary.id: Melatih pipeline deteksi objek YOLO11, verifikasi wajah dengan liveness detection, hingga kuantisasi model TFLite agar ringan berjalan di perangkat Android.
summary.en: Training YOLO11 object detection pipelines, face recognition with liveness validation, and quantizing TFLite models for on-device Android inference.

summary.id: Menyusun riset alur pengguna, design system modular berbasis token, prototipe interaktif Figma, dan audit aksesibilitas WCAG 2.2 AA.
summary.en: Structuring user flows, token-driven design systems, interactive Figma prototypes, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility compliance.

summary.id: Menjamin setiap produk rilis disertai spesifikasi arsitektur, dokumentasi API/instalasi klien-ready, serta pipeline pengujian otomatis.
summary.en: Shipping every product with written architecture specifications, client-ready operational documentation, and automated verification checks.
